cohort: 62 pregnant women with COVID-19 admitted to the ICU
finding: Of pregnant women with COVID-19 admitted to the ICU, 40% were discharged while remaining pregnant, and 60% had expedited delivery, with no significant difference in critical care complications observed between those who delivered in the ICU, those discharged from the ICU antepartum, and those admitted postpartum.
mod_finding: Antepartum women discharged from the ICU without giving birth may have lower rates of mechanical ventilation compared to those who delivered in the ICU or were admitted postpartum, but further research is needed.
gest_age: Median gestational age at SARS-CoV-2 infection and ICU admission varied between groups
